Does this line do anything? If rect isn't empty, it'll return rect. If rect is empty, it'll either return gfx::Rect() (which is empty) or rect (which is empty), depending on the flag.
Thanks - this is easier to read.
`keyboard_rect` is already a `gfx::Rect`, so you can just use `DOMRect::FromRect(keyboard_rect)` directly here as well.
Since `VirtualKeyboardOverlayRect()` returns a `const gfx::Rect&`, you can use `DOMRect::FromRect()` here to avoid the intermediate `gfx::RectF` conversion.
